title: Bash syntax gate before test run

parsed.summary: Bash syntax gate is not complete: modified/untracked shell files are not reliably included before `make test`, and the test suite is failing.
issues: Scope is not clean: out-of-scope changes are present in `tests/test_integration.py`, and the workspace also contains runtime/bookkeeping changes in `.ralph/memory/recent.md`, `progress.md`, and `tasks.json` outside the task target files.
Acceptance is not met: the new gate does not catch the modified shell candidate in the integration scenario, so tests still run through the normal flow instead of failing fast on `bash -n`.
Tests do not pass: 8 integration tests are failing, so the task cannot be approved.

Regression risk exists because the new changed-file collection relies on git diff output that misses untracked files, which is exactly the class of coder-produced shell files this gate needs to validate.
parsed.fix_instructions: Update the modified-shell discovery used by the syntax gate so it includes untracked `.sh` files created or edited by the coder before the test phase, then rerun the full test suite and keep the fast-fail path only when `bash -n` actually reports a syntax error.
parsed.progress_note: R19-02 review failed: bash syntax preflight does not yet cover the real modified-file set, and the suite remains red.
